title: BridgeCodec: Mamba Enhanced Neural Audio Codec with Schr\"odinger Bridge at Low Bitrate
abstract: arXiv:2610.15453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural audio codecs achieve remarkable performance but operate as closed ecosystems with rigidly co-trained encoderdecoder pairs, severely hindering interoperability. To resolve this, we propose BridgeCodec, a versatile framework that decouples these pairs by translating latent representations between mismatched, frozen endpoints. We formulate this cross-codec translation as a Schr\"odinger Bridge optimal transport problem, enabling robust mapping between disparate distributions without predefined noise priors. To efficiently capture longrange speech temporal dependencies, we integrate a Mambaenhanced U-Net architecture. We validate BridgeCodec on an extreme deployment scenario: mapping a lightweight 8 kHz source encoder directly to a 48 kHz target decoder at an ultralow bitrate of 1 kbps. translated_title: BridgeCodec：基于薛定谔桥与Mamba增强的低比特率神经音频编解码器
translated_abstract: 神经音频编解码器已取得卓越性能，但其运行方式如同封闭生态系统，编解码器对需严格协同训练，严重阻碍了互操作性。为解决这一问题，我们提出BridgeCodec，这是一个多功能框架，通过在不匹配的冻结端点之间转换潜在表示来解耦这些编解码器对。我们将这种跨编解码器转换表述为薛定谔桥最优传输问题，无需预定义噪声先验即可实现不同分布之间的稳健映射。为高效捕捉语音的长程时间依赖关系，我们集成了Mamba增强的U-Net架构。我们在一个极端部署场景中验证了BridgeCodec：在1 kbps的超低比特率下，将轻量级的8 kHz源编码器直接映射到48 kHz目标解码器。实验结果表明，BridgeCodec实现了卓越的宽带重建和高感知质量，成功连接了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: BridgeCodec将跨编解码器转换建模为薛定谔桥最优传输问题，结合Mamba增强的U-Net架构，在冻结的异构编解码器之间转换潜在表示，实现了1 kbps超低比特率下从8 kHz轻量编码器到48 kHz解码器的高质量宽带语音重建。
en_tdlr: BridgeCodec formulates cross-codec translation as a Schrödinger Bridge optimal transport problem with a Mamba-enhanced U-Net, decoupling frozen mismatched codec endpoints and achieving superior wideband reconstruction at an ultralow 1 kbps bitrate by mapping a lightweight 8 kHz encoder to a 48 kHz decoder.
